description: This file defines multiple Orleans grain interfaces used for testing, including methods for identity verification, runtime info retrieval, messaging, and control operations within a distributed system.

methods.name: GetKey
methods.description: Retrieves the unique key of the grain, either integer or GUID based on the interface.

methods.name: GetLabel
methods.description: Gets the label associated with the grain.

methods.name: SetLabel
methods.description: Sets a label for the grain.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Retrieves the runtime instance ID of the grain.

methods.name: GetActivationId
methods.description: Retrieves the activation ID of the grain.

methods.name: GetGrainReference
methods.description: Returns a reference to the grain itself.

methods.name: TestRequestContext
methods.description: Returns a tuple of strings representing request context information.

methods.name: GetMultipleGrainInterfaces_Array
methods.description: Returns multiple grain interfaces as an array.

methods.name: GetMultipleGrainInterfaces_List
methods.description: Returns multiple grain interfaces as a list.

methods.name: StartTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer within the grain.

methods.name: DoLongAction
methods.description: Performs a long-running action with a specified timespan and string parameter.

methods.name: GetSiloAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the address of the silo hosting the grain.

methods.name: GetPrimaryForGrain
methods.description: Gets the primary silo address for the grain.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Sends a notification to an observer.

methods.name: NotifyValueTask
methods.description: Asynchronously notifies an observer using ValueTask.

methods.name: ThrowsOneWay
methods.description: Method that throws an exception, marked as one-way.

methods.name: ThrowsOneWayValueTask
methods.description: Throws an exception asynchronously, marked as one-way with ValueTask.

methods.name: NotifyOtherGrain
methods.description: Notifies another grain and returns a boolean result.

methods.name: NotifyOtherGrainValueTask
methods.description: Asynchronously notifies another grain with ValueTask.

methods.name: GetOtherGrain
methods.description: Retrieves a reference to another grain.

methods.name: NotifyOtherGrain
methods.description: Notifies another grain without returning a result.

methods.name: GetCount
methods.description: Returns a count value from the grain.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the grain.

methods.name: GetActivationAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the activation address for a given grain.

methods.name: SignalSelfViaOther
methods.description: Signals itself via another grain.

methods.name: SendSignalTo
methods.description: Sends a signal to another grain, marked as one-way.

methods.name: WaitForSignal
methods.description: Waits for a signal, returning the number of signals and the signaller ID.

methods.name: Signal
methods.description: Sends a signal with an ID.
